purpose: Broad public-domain information-channel discovery beyond price-derived signals.

candidates.name: House transaction disclosure × exposed-industry state
candidates.hypothesis: Public House financial-disclosure transactions may create an issuer/industry information-timing state distinct from market history.
candidates.construction: Use fixed public posting time, transaction-date semantics and a pre-frozen issuer/industry exposure map; only disclosures observable by the cutoff enter the state, with no political forecasting or return-based labeling.

candidates.name: Lobbying-intensity transition × issuer/industry exposure
candidates.hypothesis: A fixed transition in disclosed lobbying activity may define an information-demand state for a pre-registered issuer/industry map.
candidates.construction: Construct a deterministic transition in public lobbying registration/report activity using the public filing/posting boundary and a frozen issuer/issue mapping; never hand-score issue sentiment or tune transition thresholds.

candidates.name: Drug shortage/manufacturing shock × pharma exposure
candidates.next_gate: event timestamp, manufacturer mapping, revision/update audit
candidates.hypothesis: A newly public drug shortage, recall or manufacturing event may create an operational information state for exposed pharmaceutical issuers.
candidates.construction: Encode fixed openFDA drug event classes using the proven public observation/update boundary and pre-frozen manufacturer/product-to-issuer mapping; occurrence, database update and public observation times remain separate.

candidates.name: Medical-device recall/enforcement shock × manufacturer exposure
candidates.next_gate: recall/enforcement dissemination clock and manufacturer mapping
candidates.hypothesis: A newly public medical-device recall or enforcement event may create an operational or regulatory information state for exposed manufacturers.
candidates.construction: Use fixed openFDA device recall/enforcement event classes and dissemination timing with a frozen manufacturer/issuer map; later revisions cannot rewrite an earlier state.

candidates.name: Cyber exploitation shock × issuer technology exposure
candidates.next_gate: publication-time contract and fixed product-to-issuer map
candidates.hypothesis: A newly published or newly exploited software vulnerability may create a technology-risk information state for exposed issuers.
candidates.construction: Translate fixed CISA KEV/NVD publication events through a pre-registered product-to-issuer graph; publication time is the information boundary and no future incident outcome or post-publication severity reassessment is used.

candidates.name: SEC FOIA topic heat × issuer information-demand state
candidates.next_gate: request/received/closed date semantics and topic-to-issuer mapping
candidates.hypothesis: Unusually concentrated SEC FOIA demand may define a public information-demand state around an issuer or topic.
candidates.construction: Construct a fixed request-intensity state from public receipt metadata using request/received/closed date semantics and a pre-frozen topic-to-issuer map; closure information cannot enter an earlier state.

candidates.name: Federal Register rule-change exposure × industry
candidates.next_gate: publication/effective-date contract and fixed exposure classes
candidates.hypothesis: A newly published Federal Register rule or order may create an industry-specific regulatory information state.
candidates.construction: Use a fixed event taxonomy keyed to public Federal Register publication, with effective date kept distinct and exposure classes frozen before observation; next-session use remains the default unless exact dissemination timing is proven.

candidates.name: Disaster shock × geographic operating exposure
candidates.next_gate: disaster/publication timestamp and geographic exposure map
candidates.hypothesis: Public disaster declarations combined with geographic operating exposure may create a heterogeneous operational-shock state.
candidates.construction: Combine fixed FEMA declaration and NOAA event states with a pre-frozen issuer geography map; publication/observation time is separate from event occurrence and later geographic information cannot alter past exposure.

candidates.name: Agricultural release shock × food/input-chain exposure
candidates.next_gate: release timestamp/vintage and fixed commodity exposure map
candidates.hypothesis: Agricultural release states may create food and input-chain information shocks for exposed issuers.
candidates.construction: Use a fixed USDA NASS release-state compiler with a pre-frozen issuer/commodity exposure map and NOAA context observed only within the proven release/vintage boundary; no future revision is backfilled.

candidates.name: Freight-flow composition shock × industrial exposure
candidates.next_gate: historical FAF vintage and industry concordance
candidates.hypothesis: Changes in freight-flow composition may create a slow-moving supply-chain information state for exposed industries.
candidates.construction: Use fixed BTS FAF historical-vintage observations mapped through a frozen industry concordance; dataset vintage is part of the state and no return-based route selection is permitted.

candidates.name: Power-system stress × electricity-intensive issuer state
candidates.next_gate: continuous-update release boundary and fixed energy-intensity map
candidates.hypothesis: Power-system stress may interact with a fixed issuer energy-intensity classification to define an operational information state.
candidates.construction: Use public EIA electricity observations under a frozen release/vintage boundary with a pre-frozen energy-intensity map; continuous updates cannot rewrite historical states.

candidates.name: Environmental enforcement shock × facility-exposed issuer
candidates.next_gate: agency action timestamp, facility identity and issuer mapping
candidates.hypothesis: A newly public environmental enforcement action may create a facility-specific operational or regulatory information state.
candidates.construction: Use a fixed EPA action taxonomy and facility identity mapping linked to issuers before evaluation; the agency public action timestamp is distinct from incident dates and later entity corrections cannot leak backward.

candidates.name: Federal award concentration × contractor ecosystem
candidates.next_gate: transaction publication/amendment semantics and contractor graph
candidates.hypothesis: Federal award concentration may define a contractor-ecosystem information state when newly published award transitions occur.
candidates.construction: Construct a fixed issuer/contractor graph from USAspending public award identities and dissemination timestamps; amendments remain separate from initial publication and contractor identity changes are frozen.

candidates.name: Competition-enforcement shock × industry network
candidates.next_gate: event publication clock and fixed peer/exposure graph
candidates.hypothesis: A public competition-enforcement action may alter information states across a fixed industry peer network.
candidates.construction: Use a fixed FTC/DOJ event taxonomy and pre-frozen peer/exposure graph keyed to public publication; later case developments cannot rewrite the initial event state.
